content:
Below is a focused Crossplane implementation for the requested S3, RDS, and IAM resources. It uses pipeline/function mode with `function-patch-and-transform`.

It assumes:

- Upbound AWS provider families are installed for S3, RDS, and IAM.
- `function-patch-and-transform` is installed as `function-patch-and-transform`.
- The referenced `ProviderConfig` objects already exist.
- RDS subnet groups and security groups already exist in each environment.
- EKS OIDC providers already exist.
- AWS RDS manages the master password in Secrets Manager, so no plaintext database password is stored in Git.

```yaml
# xrd-and-composition.yaml
---
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xversionedapplications.platform.example.io
spec:
  group: platform.example.io
  names:
    kind: XVersionedApplication
    plural: xversionedapplications
  claimNames:
    kind: VersionedApplication
    plural: versionedapplications
  defaultCompositionRef:
    name: versioned-application-aws
  versions:
    - name: v1alpha1
      served: true
      referenceable: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          required:
            - spec
          properties:
            spec:
              type: object
              required:
                - environment
                - region
                - providerConfigRef
                - bucketName
                - database
                - serviceAccountRole
              properties:
                environment:
                  type: string
                  enum:
                    - dev
                    - prod

                region:
                  type: string
                  description: AWS region in which resources are provisioned.

                providerConfigRef:
                  type: string
                  description: Name of the AWS ProviderConfig for this environment.

                bucketName:
                  type: string
                  description: Globally unique S3 bucket name.
                  minLength: 3
                  maxLength: 63

                database:
                  type: object
                  required:
                    - instanceClass
                    - allocatedStorage
                    - dbName
                    - username
                    - subnetGroupName
                    - securityGroupIds
                  properties:
                    instanceClass:
                      type: string
                      enum:
                        - db.t3.micro
                        - db.t3.medium
                    allocatedStorage:
                      type: integer
                      minimum: 20
                    dbName:
                      type: string
                      pattern: "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$"
                    username:
                      type: string
                      minLength: 1
                    subnetGroupName:
                      type: string
                    securityGroupIds:
                      type: array
                      minItems: 1
                      items:
                        type: string
                    multiAZ:
                      type: boolean
                      default: false
                    backupRetentionDays:
                      type: integer
                      minimum: 7
                      maximum: 35
                      default: 7

                serviceAccountRole:
                  type: object
                  required:
                    - roleName
                    - oidcProviderArn
                    - oidcIssuerHost
                    - namespace
                    - serviceAccountName
                  properties:
                    roleName:
                      type: string
                    oidcProviderArn:
                      type: string
                      description: ARN of the EKS cluster IAM OIDC provider.
                    oidcIssuerHost:
                      type: string
                      description: >-
                        OIDC issuer without the https:// prefix, for example
                        oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLE.
                    namespace:
                      type: string
                    serviceAccountName:
                      type: string

            status:
              type: object
              properties:
                bucketARN:
                  type: string
                databaseEndpoint:
                  type: string
                databaseMasterSecretARN:
                  type: string
                iamRoleARN:
                  type: string

---
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: versioned-application-aws
  labels:
    provider: aws
    platform.example.io/type: versioned-application
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: platform.example.io/v1alpha1
    kind: XVersionedApplication

  mode: Pipeline
  pipeline:
    - step: patch-and-transform
      functionRef:
        name: function-patch-and-transform
      input:
        apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Resources
        resources:
          # The bucket itself. Versioning, encryption, and public-access
          # controls are represented by separate S3 provider resources.
          - name: bucket
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
              kind: Bucket
              metadata:
                annotations:
                  crossplane.io/external-name: placeholder
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  forceDestroy: false
                  tags:
                    ManagedBy: crossplane
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.Environment

              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
                toFieldPath: status.bucketARN
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional

          - name: bucket-versioning
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketVersioning
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  versioningConfiguration:
                    - status: Enabled
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

          - name: bucket-encryption
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  rule:
                    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                        - sseAlgorithm: AES256
                      bucketKeyEnabled: false
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

          - name: bucket-public-access-block
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  blockPublicAcls: true
                  blockPublicPolicy: true
                  ignorePublicAcls: true
                  restrictPublicBuckets: true
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

          # AWS manages the master password and stores it in Secrets Manager.
          # The password is therefore not committed to Git or placed in the XR.
          - name: postgres
            base:
              apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
              kind: Instance
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  engine: postgres
                  instanceClass: db.t3.micro
                  allocatedStorage: 20
                  storageType: gp3

                  dbName: app
                  username: app_admin
                  manageMasterUserPassword: true

                  storageEncrypted: true
                  deletionProtection: true
                  publiclyAccessible: false
                  backupRetentionPeriod: 7
                  copyTagsToSnapshot: true
                  autoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
                  multiAz: false

                  dbSubnetGroupName: placeholder
                  vpcSecurityGroupIds:
                    - sg-placeholder

                  tags:
                    ManagedBy: crossplane
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.Environment

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.instanceClass
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.allocatedStorage
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.allocatedStorage

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.dbName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbName

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.username
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.username

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.subnetGroupName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbSubnetGroupName

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.securityGroupIds
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.vpcSecurityGroupIds

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.multiAZ
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAz

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.backupRetentionDays
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.backupRetentionPeriod

              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.endpoint
                toFieldPath: status.databaseEndpoint
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional

              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.masterUserSecret[0].secretArn
                toFieldPath: status.databaseMasterSecretARN
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional

          # IAM role with EKS IRSA web-identity trust.
          - name: service-account-role
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Role
              metadata:
                annotations:
                  crossplane.io/external-name: placeholder
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  assumeRolePolicy: "{}"
                  maxSessionDuration: 3600
                  tags:
                    ManagedBy: crossplane
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.serviceAccountRole.roleName
                toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.Environment

              - type: CombineFromComposite
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy
                combine:
                  strategy: string
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.serviceAccountRole.oidcProviderArn
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.serviceAccountRole.oidcIssuerHost
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.serviceAccountRole.oidcIssuerHost
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.serviceAccountRole.namespace
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.serviceAccountRole.serviceAccountName
                  string:
                    fmt: >-
                      {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Federated":"%s"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"%s:aud":"sts.amazonaws.com","%s:sub":"system:serviceaccount:%s:%s"}}}]}

              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
                toFieldPath: status.iamRoleARN
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional

          # Inline least-privilege S3 policy. It grants only the actions needed
          # to list the configured bucket and read/write/delete its objects.
          # There are no wildcard actions.
          - name: service-account-role-policy
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: RolePolicy
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  name: application-assets
                  roleSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  policy: "{}"
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

              - type: CombineFromComposite
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policy
                combine:
                  strategy: string
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                  string:
                    fmt: >-
                      {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Sid":"ListApplicationAssets","Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:ListBucket","s3:GetBucketLocation"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::%s"},{"Sid":"ManageApplicationAssets","Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:PutObject","s3:DeleteObject","s3:GetObjectVersion"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::%s/*"}]}

    - step: automatically-detect-readiness
      functionRef:
        name: function-auto-ready
```

  bucketName: example-company-web-assets-dev

  database:
    instanceClass: db.t3.micro
    allocatedStorage: 20

    username: application_admin

    securityGroupIds:

    backupRetentionDays: 7

  serviceAccountRole:

```yaml
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Function
metadata:
  name: function-patch-and-transform
spec:
  package: xpkg.crossplane.io/crossplane-contrib/function-patch-and-transform:v0.8.2
---
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Function
metadata:
  name: function-auto-ready
spec:
  package: xpkg.crossplane.io/crossplane-contrib/function-auto-ready:v0.5.0
```

The exact provider API versions can vary with the installed Upbound AWS provider release. If a release exposes an S3 child resource as `v1beta2` rather than `v1beta1`, only that resource’s `apiVersion` needs to be adjusted. This implementation covers the requested subset; EKS, HTTPS exposure, and production cross-region S3 replication require additional composed resources.
